nodes.label: App Icon (icon.png)
nodes.description: Round app icon: cartoon white hen with red comb/bandana holding a dark weapon, on a green circular badge with thick dark outline; flat cartoon style suitable for Windows/Android launcher icons

nodes.label: Armed Chicken Mascot
nodes.rationale: A combat-ready hen visually encodes the game's theme (battle chicken coop) in a single recognizable character

nodes.label: Flat Cartoon Circular Badge Style
nodes.rationale: Circular green badge with bold outlines stays legible at small launcher sizes on Windows and Android

nodes.label: Kuriatnyk App Icon (512px)
nodes.description: 512x512 application icon: flat cartoon white chicken with red comb and red bandana holding a dark gun, standing on a green circular badge with a bold dark outline. Used as the Windows/Android launcher icon for the Battle Chicken Coop game.

nodes.label: Armed Chicken Mascot
nodes.rationale: The bandana-wearing chicken holding a weapon conveys the game's combat/shooter theme (Battle Chicken Coop, Soul Knight-style mode) in a single readable silhouette.

nodes.label: Flat Cartoon Icon Style
nodes.rationale: Thick dark outlines, limited palette (green, white, red, orange) and a circular badge keep the icon legible at small launcher sizes on both Windows and Android.

nodes.label: Kuriatnyk.Android (Android launcher)
nodes.rationale: Landscape only; debug-signed APK, Google Play needs own AndroidSigningKeyStore

nodes.label: Avalonia 11.3
nodes.rationale: Shared UI for desktop and mobile

nodes.label: Game module (src/Kuriatnyk/Game)
nodes.rationale: Data.cs, World.cs, Dungeon.cs, Combat.cs, Weapons.cs, Update.cs, Flow.cs, SkData.cs, SkPlay.cs, Offers.cs

nodes.label: Render module (Ctx.cs, Draw.*.cs, Hud.cs)
nodes.rationale: Ctx.cs is a canvas-style API over Skia

nodes.label: KUR_DATA_DIR env var
nodes.rationale: Overrides save folder so tests don't touch real progress

nodes.label: Code-Synthesized Audio
nodes.rationale: Sound and music synthesized in code (no audio files): WASAPI via NAudio on Windows, AudioTrack on Android

nodes.label: Battle Coop (Boevoy Kuryatnik)
nodes.rationale: Works fully offline: graphics, sound, fonts and saves are built into the app; targets Windows and Android

nodes.label: Bird Statue Shrine
nodes.rationale: Paid with pivchiki; stronger ultimates cost more; replaces the hero's ultimate for the rest of the run

nodes.label: tools/Snap (headless check)
nodes.rationale: Headless battle run saving PNG frames; modes perf, sk, story, glyphs; also icon generator

nodes.label: Soul Knight Mode
nodes.rationale: Roguelike run through forest dungeon 0-1..0-5 and factory catacombs 1-1..1-5; no grenades, no passive HP regen, stamina spent on shots

nodes.label: Soul Knight Passives
nodes.rationale: Portal offers a choice of three between levels; +1 weapon slot appears only once

nodes.label: Stamina
nodes.rationale: 100 stamina, spent on shots only in Soul Knight

nodes.label: tools/export-lang.js (legacy)
nodes.rationale: Old exporter of en.json from web/js/lang.js; dictionaries are now edited directly

nodes.label: Localization (8 languages)
nodes.rationale: Switchable on the fly; JSON dictionaries keyed by the Russian strings

nodes.label: Rubik and Rubik Bubbles Fonts (SIL OFL 1.1)
nodes.norm_label: rubik and rubik bubbles fonts (sil ofl 1.1)

nodes.label: Heroes (9 in 4 classes)
nodes.rationale: Classes Assault, Tank, Sniper, Medic; each has an ultimate and two passives

nodes.label: x2 Crit Chance
nodes.rationale: 5% for everyone, 12% for snipers

nodes.label: Soul Knight Arsenal (35 weapons)
nodes.rationale: Melee, guns and 8 staffs; carry 2; every melee weapon deflects eggs back at enemies

nodes.label: Story Mode
nodes.rationale: 4 chapters x 20 levels, 8 bosses; every level lasts at least 3 minutes, boss arrives at 1:15
